results.title: asyncio TaskGroup, timeouts and semaphores tested with pytest-asyncio
results.summary: Bounded concurrent fetches with asyncio.Semaphore, per-call asyncio.timeout and TaskGroup error handling, tested offline with pytest-asyncio loop scope config and async fixtures.

results.title: SQLAlchemy 2 async ORM + aiosqlite with pytest-asyncio
results.summary: SQLAlchemy 2.x typed async ORM (Mapped, mapped_column, async_sessionmaker, selectinload) on aiosqlite, with pytest-asyncio fixtures.

results.title: anyio to_thread and from_thread bridging sync work under pytest-asyncio
results.summary: Run blocking code in worker threads with anyio.to_thread, call back into async code from those threads with anyio.from_thread, and test the whole bridge offline with pytest-asyncio.

results.title: aiofiles async file IO coordinated by anyio under pytest-asyncio
results.summary: Write and read files with aiofiles, fan out concurrent reads with an anyio task group, serialize appends with anyio.Lock, and test it all offline with pytest-asyncio.

results.title: FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy 2 on aiosqlite, tested offline with per-test in-memory DBs
results.summary: A FastAPI app using AsyncSession and async_sessionmaker on aiosqlite, tested with httpx.AsyncClient over ASGITransport, overriding the session dependency with a fresh in-memory database for each test.

results.title: SQLAlchemy 2 async session factory over aiosqlite
results.summary: An async SQLAlchemy 2.0 engine and session factory over aiosqlite, with StaticPool in-memory wiring and pytest-asyncio tests covering commit, rollback and integrity errors.

results.title: Async repository pattern with SQLAlchemy 2 AsyncSession on aiosqlite
results.summary: A typed async repository over SQLAlchemy 2 AsyncSession with eager loading, foreign keys enforced on SQLite, and offline pytest-asyncio tests against an in-memory database.

results.title: aiohttp routes tested offline with the pytest-aiohttp test client
results.summary: An aiohttp JSON app exercised through the pytest-aiohttp in-process test client, plus a conftest that brings loopback up so the client runs inside a network-isolated sandbox.

results.title: pytest fixtures + factory_boy with SQLAlchemy 2 sessions
results.summary: Transactional pytest fixtures that roll back per test, plus factory_boy SQLAlchemy factories with sequences, SubFactory and traits.

results.title: Tortoise ORM relations and filters on sqlite under pytest-asyncio
results.summary: Model foreign keys, reverse and many-to-many relations in Tortoise ORM, then exercise select_related, prefetch_related, dotted filters, distinct and annotate counts offline on in-memory sqlite.
